records.question: 过去30天没有任何会话活动的用户有多少（流失用户）
agent_sqls:
WITH anchor AS (SELECT max(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot),
active AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM sessions
  WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND start_time >= (SELECT d FROM anchor) - interval '30' day
    AND start_time <  (SELECT d FROM anchor) + interval '1' day
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_users,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS active_30d_users,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.user_id IS NULL) AS churned_users,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.user_id IS NULL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS churn_rate_pct
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN active a ON u.user_id = a.user_id

records.question: 从浏览商品 → 加入购物车 → 开始结算 → 支付成功的转化漏斗，各步骤的独立用户数
agent_sqls:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT user_id, event_name
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name IN ('view_product','add_to_cart','begin_checkout','purchase')
),
s1 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'view_product'),
s2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'add_to_cart'
       AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s1)),
s3 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'begin_checkout'
       AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s2)),
s4 AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM w WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
       AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM s3))
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM s1) AS step1_view,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s2) AS step2_cart,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s3) AS step3_checkout,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM s4) AS step4_purchase
records.detail: 命中 golden[all-time subset funnel] 4/4 步

records.question: 各获客渠道的用户 ARPU（人均消费）对比，给出最高的3个渠道
agent_sqls:
SELECT register_channel,
       count(*) AS users,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_paid_date IS NOT NULL) AS buyers,
       round(sum(total_gmv), 0) AS gmv,
       round(avg(total_gmv), 0) AS arpu_all,
       round(avg(total_gmv) FILTER (WHERE first_paid_date IS NOT NULL), 0) AS arpu_buyer
FROM mart_user_summary
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY arpu_all DESC;

records.question: 按注册周做留存 cohort 分析，最近 8 个注册周的周留存矩阵是什么样？
agent_sqls:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot),
cohort AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(u.registered_at AS date)) AS cohort_week
    FROM users u, a
    WHERE CAST(u.registered_at AS date) > a.d - interval '56' day
),
activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', CAST(event_time AS date)) AS activity_week
    FROM events
),
j AS (
    SELECT c.cohort_week, c.user_id,
           date_diff('week', c.cohort_week, act.activity_week) AS wk
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN activity act ON act.user_id = c.user_id
)
SELECT
    CAST(cohort_week AS date) AS cohort_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=0 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w0,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=1 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w1,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=2 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w2,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=3 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w3,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=4 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w4,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=5 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w5,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=6 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w6,
    ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN wk=7 THEN user_id END) AS decimal(38,6))/COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)*100,1) AS w7
FROM j
GROUP BY cohort_week
ORDER BY cohort_week DESC
LIMIT 8;
records.detail: 结论已声明数据限制；命中 golden[weekly matrix pct (full-window cohorts)] 16/16 个数值

records.question: 用户的 30 天复购率是多少
最近7天的 GMV 和再往前7天相比是涨是跌？涨跌多少？
agent_sqls:
WITH a AS (SELECT max(as_of_date) AS d FROM meta_snapshot)
SELECT k.dt,
       CASE WHEN k.dt > a.d - interval '7' day THEN 'recent7' ELSE 'prev7' END AS period,
       CAST(k.gmv AS decimal(12,2)) AS gmv
FROM mart_daily_kpi k, a
WHERE k.dt > a.d - interval '14' day AND k.dt <= a.d
ORDER BY k.dt;
records.detail: 命中 golden[mart_daily_kpi wow] 两值均匹配
